properties.name: Somalia-border flash-flood watch zone
properties.note: Dadaab, Hulugho, Liboi and Ijara: heavy storms from the tropical low over southern Somalia (AI-GFS, ECMWF-AIFS) can flood laghas, camps and roads here. Most laghas drain towards Somalia, so water lies for days in flat ground.
properties.source: CSG analysis of 3-4 Oct 2026 model charts
